title: Known Unknowns
tagline: The bodies that are easy to reach and badly known: condition code and data arc crossed with screening C3, and the list an observing plan would start from.
pitch: Half the catalog has condition code 7 or worse (measured: 9,587 at U=7, 8,958 at 8, 3,281 at 9) and the median data arc is 22 days, yet 98.8% of bodies clear the screening threshold. This study crosses the two: minimum C3 bands against U, data-arc and observation-count bands, with a 'what-if gate' you set with two sliders (U at most u, arc at least d days) that shows how many low-C3 bodies would survive and which would not. Its product is a ranked table of accessible-but-poorly-determined bodies with their best screening window dates and H: the raw material the Survey lens needs to turn `what_would_help` into 'recover this object before its window'. It also checks the stored `qualityRank` against its own published formula for every body. The user learns that accessibility and knowledge are anti-correlated in this catalog, and by how much.
whyNow: Survey lens in `strategy/ASTER_FAMILY_MASTER_PLAN.md` ('turn `what_would_help` into an observing plan'); `tests/fixtures/v2/nea-catalog-slice9.spec.md` (`planning-tier` reserved, never numerically assigned; the `qualityRank` formula); `src/v2/SLICE_18_FOUNDING.md` 'Q ANSWERED — condition code does NOT predict propagation error' with its structural caveat that U's actual claim (solution error) was untestable there; INV-028 refusals with `what_would_help` in `mcp/src/tools/envelope-schema.ts`.
computes: Inputs: catalog (conditionCode, dataArcDays, nObsUsed, qualityRank, H, orbitClass) joined to the cache (minC3, minC3Date, bestWindows) by bodyId; `metadata.feasibleC3MaxKm2S2` and the near-zero constant define the C3 band edges. Outputs: three-way cross-tabs (C3 band × U, × arc band, × nObs band) with null bands; survivor curves for every (u, d) pair on a grid; a top-N list (minC3 ascending within U ≥ 7 and arc < 30 d) with designation, class, H, U, arc, nObs, best launchDate, tofDays, c3, vInfArr; qualityRank recomputed from the spec formula vs stored.
dataNeeded: Cross-tab and survivor-grid JSON (~30 KB, sidecar-only); top-200 list as a joined excerpt via the stratum cutter `--must` (~40 KB); cache `metadata` excerpt; near-zero constant snapshot. About 75 KB.
existingOverlap: The compare page explains U per body in prose; `qualityRank` is stored but 'does not prescribe UI visuals'; Slice 18 correlated U with model drift on 17 bodies; MCP `search_bodies` filters by orbitClass and screeningStatus only (`mcp/src/tools/search-bodies.ts:15`). No catalog-wide quality × accessibility table exists. This is about solution quality, which Slice 18 explicitly could not test.
honestyRisks: U and arc measure orbit-determination quality, not model error, and the page quotes Slice 18's caveat verbatim so the two are not conflated. 'Accessible' means screening minC3 on the single-rev 7×30-day grid, named from metadata. The list is a sorted table, not a recommendation, and the sliders are labelled 'what-if gate', never 'planning tier' (which is Aster policy the fixture reserves). No observability is computed (no magnitude, no sky position); the README says an observing plan needs an observer model this idea lacks. Null-U and null-arc bodies are their own bands.
testPlan: All cross-tab cells sum to 41,906; the U marginal equals the measured distribution {0: 8470, 1: 1705, 2: 651, 3: 477, 4: 1189, 5: 2468, 6: 5110, 7: 9587, 8: 8958, 9: 3281, null: 10}; qualityRank recomputed via the spec formula equals the stored value within 1e-6 for every body (reconciliation to the fixture's own formula string); survivor count is monotone in u and in d; every listed body has minC3 ≤ threshold, U ≥ 7 and arc < 30 or null; the cache threshold is read from metadata and the test fails if a literal 25 appears in the page source; smoke at 390 px with both sliders dragged.
landing: Aster MCP as filters on `search_bodies` (conditionCode, dataArcDays) and as the Survey lens's first artefact, where an INV-028 refusal would carry `what_would_help: 'extend the data arc'`; needs a founding-doc seat and the envelope's provenance refs; nothing here has been through those.
notes: Verified the U distribution exactly ({7: 9587, 8: 8958, 0: 8470, …, null: 10}) and the qualityRank formula string. First Survey-lens artefact; search_bodies has no U/arc filter.
